data.title: GCC Secretary General Meets NATO Secretary General's Special Representative for the Southern Neighborhood
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA – Secretary General of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi met today with NATO Secretary General's Special Representative for the Southern Neighborhood and Deputy Assistant Secretary General for Political Affairs Javier Colomina in Naples, Italy, on the sidelines of his participation in the 12th edition of the Rome Mediterranean Dialogues Forum.
    During the meeting, they discussed several proposals to strengthen cooperation and coordination between the GCC and NATO and reviewed regional and international issues of mutual interest, particularly the latest security developments in the region and efforts to support regional and international security and stability.
    Both sides also emphasized the importance of continuing consultations and exchanging views on issues of mutual interest, as well as strengthening cooperation to promote security and stability in the region.
    -- SPA
